answer: Ivory Threshold Detection After each transaction batch, compute the average entropy of message content across identities. Identities whose messages fall below a dynamically adjusted threshold—set by the median entropy of the top 90% of active agents—are flagged. Crystal consistency checks verify whether flagged agents exhibit statistically identical linguistic patterns across time and context. Agents failing this test are suspended. Orchard-level validation runs a chi-squared test on interaction sequences to detect non-random clustering indicative of synthetic behavior.
